cmd.description: The primary command to execute for each argument.

max_args.description: Maximum number of arguments to pass to each command invocation (-N).

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of processes to run concurrently (-j). 0 uses all cores.

replace_arg.description: String to replace with the argument in the command line (-I).

nuls.description: Use NUL bytes as separators instead of newlines (-0).

fatal.description: Stop immediately if any command execution fails (-F).

require_args.description: Return error if no arguments are provided (-R).

verbose.description: Print commands to stderr before running them (-v).

percent_rules.description: Enable make-style percent rules for pattern matching (-p).

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match arguments when using percent rules.

shell_script.description: Shell script to execute with arguments as $1, $2, etc. (-s). Empty string disables this mode.

arg_sep.description: Custom separator for command and args when using -A mode. Empty for default.

args_list.description: List of arguments/items to process. If percent_rules is true, these are the files to match against the pattern.
